summary: Remove Sub_Type__c from Lead page layout and make it non-required

description.raw: User Story As a Product Owner / Sales Ops I want the Lead field  Sub_Type__c  removed from the Lead page layout and ensured to be non-required So that users no longer see the field when creating or editing Leads and the field is not enforced as mandatory by the UI or automation Description / Scope Remove  Sub_Type__c  from all Lead page layouts used by business users (Lightning and Classic as applicable). Ensure  Sub_Type__c  is  not required  anywhere: remove any page-layout-level required setting, validation rules, Flow/Apex enforcement, and any Process Builder checks that make it mandatory. Do  not  delete the field from the schema unless a separate request is made — simply remove it from the UI and stop treating it as required. Ensure integrations and automated jobs are not forced to provide the field (i.e., remove required enforcement from server-side rules) Acceptance Criteria (GIVEN / WHEN / THEN) Page layout removal GIVEN a standard user opens or edits a Lead in Lightning Experience WHEN they view Lead record pages THEN Sub_Type__c is not visible anywhere on the page  Not required in UI GIVEN a user creates or edits a Lead where Sub_Type__c is blank WHEN they save the Lead THEN the save succeeds and no UI error requests Sub_Type__c be populated Not required by automation GIVEN Flows, Validation Rules, Process Builders, Apex or other server-side automation that previously enforced Sub_Type__c as required WHEN those automations run after the change THEN none of them block Lead creation/update for a missing Sub_Type__c; any enforcement is removed or updated API / Integrations GIVEN an integration or API client that creates/updates Leads without Sub_Type__c WHEN the integration runs THEN requests are accepted and not rejected for missing Sub_Type__c (unless other business rules apply)
